text:
Maya (Support): Customer (acme-ml / acct abc-123) says their promo credits were consumed before their free pool, leaving them with 0 promo and full-looking free credits on the dashboard. They noticed it after a billing preview. Can someone triage? Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ss/abc-123.png
Alex (Billing): Can you paste an example request id and timestamp? Are these text-gen tokens or embeddings?
Maya (Support): Example req: req_20260210_01, timestamp 2026-02-10T15:12:04Z. Looks like text-gen (completion) calls, ~12k tokens total in that day. Customer says promo was added 2026-02-09 23:50 UTC, free pool listed on account created 2026-01-01.
Alex (Billing): Quick check of ledger shows two credit grants: free_pool grant id fp_789 on 2026-01-01, promo grant id promo_456 applied 2026-02-09T23:50Z. By policy promo should be burned after free_pool (free pool first). Weird.
billing-bot: event: grant_applied {"account_id":"abc-123","grant_id":"promo_456","type":"promo","ts":"2026-02-09T23:50:02Z"} :information_source:
Priya (Eng): Can you run the ledger query and paste rows around the usage time? e.g. run:```sql
SELECT ts, event_type, grant_id, amount, balance_after
FROM credit_ledger
WHERE account_id='abc-123' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-10' AND '2026-02-11'
ORDER BY ts;
```
Maya (Support): Pasted output (sanitized):```txt
2026-02-10T15:11:59Z usage req_20260210_00 -1200 free_pool balance: 8800
2026-02-10T15:12:04Z usage req_20260210_01 -1300 promo balance: 700
2026-02-10T15:12:05Z usage req_20260210_02 -1800 promo balance: -1100
```
Priya (Eng): Huh — looks like the app debited promo credits mid-window before exhausting free_pool. Two quick hypotheses: 1) grant precedence metadata was overwritten during a grant migration job, or 2) the charge router used a fallback model that maps usage to promo-type buckets when free_pool per-request allocation is missing.
Alex (Billing): Promo metadata shows "priority": 200, free_pool shows "priority": 100. That should make free_pool consume first. But there was a grant_migration job on 2026-02-09T23:49Z per ops logs.
Priya (Eng): Can you share the migration job logs for account abc-123? Also need the per-request routing payload for req_20260210_01 (headers + grant lookup call).
Maya (Support): Attached migration job snippet:```json
{"ts":"2026-02-09T23:49:58Z","job":"grant_migration","account":"abc-123","changes":[{"grant_id":"promo_456","new_priority":100}]}
``` Customer claims they did not change anything.
Priya (Eng): Ok that explains it — migration momentarily set promo priority to 100, same as free_pool, and our deterministic tie-breaker uses lexicographic grant_id order (promo_456 ordered before fp_789), so promo got consumed first. This is a bug: migration should preserve original precedence or set promo lower than free_pool. I'll open an issue. :bug:
Alex (Billing): For customer impact: we can issue a manual ledger correction to restore tokens (refund equivalent tokens to free_pool) and credit them for the delta on invoice. Approving manual adjustment now.
Maya (Support): Customer asks for temporary mitigation: can we pause the migration job or roll back the change for their account?
Priya (Eng): I can push a targeted rollback to set promo_456 priority back to 200 for abc-123. Command:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/grants/priority \ 
  -d '{"account_id":"abc-123","grant_id":"promo_456","priority":200}'
```
billing-bot: action: admin_change {"account_id":"abc-123","grant_id":"promo_456","new_priority":200,"ts":"2026-02-10T15:14:30Z"} :white_check_mark:
Priya (Eng): Rolled back. I also put a one-hour block on the migration job for accounts with mixed grants so we don't hit others. Issue #INF-842 tracking to make deterministic tie-breaker use grant creation time.
Alex (Billing): Manual ledger adjustment queued: adj_9001 +2400 tokens to free_pool, ticket #TCK-4589. Will reflect on customer's billing preview in ~10m.
Maya (Support): Thanks team — I'll update customer: rollback done, manual adjustment queued, we will refund any overcharged units if invoice already generated. :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya (Eng): Follow-up: adding regression test to migration pipeline to assert explicit precedence mapping. Also adding an alert when migration changes grant.priority.
Maya (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks, please confirm once the preview shows corrected balance — we're blocked on a demo."
Alex (Billing): Preview updated: https://billing.redwood/app/acct/abc-123/preview — shows promo: 0 used, free_pool: used 2400, remaining 6400. Forwarding to customer. :thumbsup:
